description_zh: M3 原生模块状态、IMU 内部状态、M1 inference_output.v3 状态及单位字符串之间的唯一确定性映射。任何未登记值均 fail closed。
description_en: Sole deterministic mapping among native M3 module states, internal IMU states, m1.inference_output.v3 states and unit strings. Every unregistered value fails closed.

finite_numeric_policy.description_zh: 缺失数值必须是 null，并同时带掩码和原因码；不得写入非标准 JSON 浮点字面量。
finite_numeric_policy.description_en: Missing numerics are null with a mask and reason code; non-standard JSON floating literals are forbidden.

imu_internal_state_projection.description_zh: EKF 就绪门、协方差门和更新条件均满足。
imu_internal_state_projection.description_en: EKF readiness, covariance and update gates are satisfied.

imu_internal_state_projection.description_zh: 允许的短时纯预测，必须同时报告 prediction_only 原因；超过时限转 no_estimate。
imu_internal_state_projection.description_en: Allowed short prediction-only interval with an explicit reason; exceeding the limit becomes no_estimate.

imu_internal_state_projection.description_zh: 就绪、协方差、偏置或纯预测时限失败。
imu_internal_state_projection.description_en: Readiness, covariance, bias or prediction-only duration gate failed.

unit_normalization.description_zh: 仅规范字符串拼写，不改变数值。
unit_normalization.description_en: Normalizes spelling only and does not change numeric values.

unit_normalization.description_zh: 使用冻结标准重力常数显式换算。
unit_normalization.description_en: Explicit conversion using the frozen standard-gravity constant.

unit_normalization.description_zh: 单位已为 SI，无数值换算。
保留原始计数与 DC/AC，不按幅值猜单位。
unit_normalization.description_en: Preserves raw counts and DC/AC; units are never guessed from amplitude.

unit_normalization.description_zh: 未知单位显式无结果，不做幅值启发式推断。
unit_normalization.description_en: Unknown units produce an explicit no-result; amplitude heuristics are forbidden.

routing_status_rules.description_zh: 先 SQI+可选 Motion detector，再分 high 与 low/motion；后者只能按会话前配置选择 drop 或 denoise→features。
routing_status_rules.description_en: SQI plus optional motion detection precedes high versus low/motion routing; the latter follows only the pre-run choice of drop or denoise-to-features.
